meta.title: 6 signs you're more emotionally intelligent than you think

beats.text: Six signs your emotional intelligence is higher than you give yourself credit for.
One. You can name exactly what you're feeling — not just 'good' or 'bad'.
Two. You pause in the gap between what happens and how you react.
Three. You don't take other people's bad moods as a verdict on you.
Four. You can sit with discomfort without rushing to numb or fix it.
Five. You can apologise properly — without a single 'but' defending yourself.
Six. You set a boundary without drowning in guilt afterwards.
If you recognised even three of these, you're further along than you think.
